description: The outreach sequence Fundz writes for one contact at one company: three short emails (first email, follow-up, last note) in the user's own sender profile, checked against Fundz events. Email one opens with what is moving in the recipient's market and names the company's own news. Also returns the user's signature and booking link, and every email this user already sent to that person or to others at the company, so nobody gets a second first email. Use this instead of composing outreach from scratch; the text is complete as returned and every fact in it is already checked, so no web search is needed to write the email. Nothing is sent. The first call for a contact can take 15 to 25 seconds; repeat calls are instant. Costs one call from the daily API quota.

company.description: Company id, slug, domain or name of the RECIPIENT

event.description: The dated event that made this company a lead, as Fundz returned it (e.g. "Raised a $12M Series A on 2026-11-03"). Email one names it.

opener.description: Optional first line the user wants email one to start with

redraft.description: true to write a fresh version instead of returning the saved one

signal_type.description: Kind of event: funding, executive, acquisition, hiring, contract, product, expansion (default funding)

name: get_smartsend_draft
title: Get SmartSend email sequence
